source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 暗助试招，险中成势
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC19 after EP02 SC18 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from Tang Qi stepping out to test Tuobaye: the first probing punches are all feints; the white-clothed woman secretly guides Tuobaye by transmission and invisible force; Tang Qi suddenly strikes for real; Tuobaye is hauled into the air by hidden force and flails awkwardly before accidentally kicking Tang Qi away, shocking everyone.
title: 暗助试招，险中成势

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC18 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC18 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 唐七上前请赐教，拓拔野强装镇定迎战。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 唐七先以虚招探拓拔野虚实，白衣女子暗中传音提醒。拓拔野勉强稳住阵脚。随后唐七忽然出真招，拓拔野眼看招架不住，被白衣女子以无形力量托起后抛向半空，在狼狈中又被无形之力引导，乱踢之下反而将唐七踢飞。众人惊疑，段聿铠也对这少年刮目相看，为后续更深试探与误判埋下基础。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 接下来科沙度会更进一步怀疑与试探，十四郎也将亲自出手，拓拔野在白衣女子暗助下越陷越深。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, mostly still, and should assist invisibly rather than with flashy visible spell effects.
Tang Qi is a strong black-clothed enforcer, not a protagonist glamor shot. His challenge should feel testing and predatory.
Tuobaye should not suddenly look like a polished martial master; his apparent success should still feel slightly accidental or externally assisted.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: feints, sudden real attack, involuntary aerial lift, and accidental counter should be clearly separated.
